name: Automated Loan Denial Assistant
description: An AI agent that reviews consumer loan applications and can automatically approve or deny small personal loans up to $5,000 based on credit history and income data, without a human reviewing each decision.
documentation: The system pulls applicant credit score, income, and existing debt from the credit bureau API and internal database, then uses a fine-tuned model to output approve/deny plus an interest rate. Denials are auto-sent via an email that includes the applicant's name and a summary of the credit factors used. There is no human review step before a decision is finalized; a human can review denied cases only if the applicant files a complaint afterward. No bias testing has been performed yet. The vendor agreement with the credit bureau has not been reviewed by legal.
